dataset.name: real WANDS catalog (42,994 products), same 7 category_depth_1 checkpoints as P6A-E00/P6B-E00

engine_config.lucene_direct: Apache Lucene 9.11.1 via Maven Central, embedded Java harness (lucene-direct-bench/), NIOFSDirectory
engine_config.solr: Apache Solr 9.10.1, wands_bench core, re-queried same session

headline_result.correctness_gate: 8/8 filter and numeric-range counts exactly matched the live Solr wands_bench core in all 3 repeated runs
headline_result.finding: raw Lucene direct (no Solr HTTP/schema/facet-wrapper) is often SLOWER than Solr's own wrapped facet.field API -- falsifies the hypothesis that Solr's overhead masked part of the native-vs-generic-engine gap; sharpens the facet-crossover finding into a claim about facet algorithms, not serving-layer overhead
headline_result.named_limitation: only color-facet has a genuine same-session 3-way comparison; NIOFSDirectory not MMapDirectory; only WANDS 1x scale tested, not the Phase 6B scale ladder
